title: FBI-UAP-D042, Digital Rendering 2, “Multiple Red Lights,” 2026
summary: This image is an artistic interpretation of a reported incident potentially involving unidentified anomalous phenomena (UAP) in the western United States in 2026. This image is based upon a first-hand description provided by two U.S. persons, as described in FBI-UAP-D040. The Federal Bureau of Investigation prepared this digital rendering in 2026 as a visual aid in support of the PURSUE initiative.
image_alt_text: A digital rendering of a light streak in the sky over a mountainous landscape, as viewed through binoculars.
